The cause is in `util.py`: `_parse_field` always returns `restricted=False`, so `day_ok` treats both day fields as wildcards. I'll make the flag reflect whether the field starts with `*`, as Vixie cron does.

Standard cron also ORs the day-of-month and day-of-week when both are restricted, but `core.py` ANDs them. Once the flag is fixed, that AND is the next wrong behavior, so I'll change it to OR too.
